kind: Expected design captured from the approved reference engine; not a React implementation capture

source.harness: about:blank page with one full-viewport canvas; the unmodified engine inlined and started with createParticleStreaks(canvas, profile).start(); profile multipliers from reference/pulso-director.js PROF

conditions.motion: animation running; screenshot taken 3 s after start
conditions.crop: Full viewport = component zone (canvas fills the viewport)

limits: The engine uses Math.random: particle positions differ on every run; compare density, palette, glow, angle and size distribution, never pixel positions.
Opacity 1 only; consumer-driven opacity and the 0.6 mobile density factor are not shown.
Captured outside the website page; no SectionShell or other overlay above the layer.

visuals.scenario: profile base: 70 lines, 90 squares, speed 1, glow 0.1
visuals.alt: Dark red-black background with diagonal glowing red streaks and scattered red diamonds of varied size and brightness, with a soft central red glow.

visuals.scenario: profile read: 20 lines, 25 squares, speed 0.6, glow 0.1
visuals.alt: Mostly empty dark red-black background with a few diagonal red streaks and sparse red diamonds.

visuals.scenario: profile live: 110 lines, 120 squares, speed 1.4, glow 0.18
visuals.alt: Dense dark red background with many diagonal glowing red streaks, numerous red diamonds and a brighter central glow.

approval.reference: Explicit owner instruction on 2026-10-17: "no dejes pendientes. todo de una cuando definamos specs. añade captura y acepta props"
approval.scope: VIS-01 to VIS-03 adopted as expected design for density, palette, glow and streak angle per profile; positions are random and not normative.
